Every route and file has been migrated from the Pages Router to the Next.js App Router:

- **Root Layout (`app/layout.tsx`)**: Replaced `_document.js` and `_app.js`, incorporating metadata, custom font preconnect links, and `AppProvider`.
- **Home Route (`app/page.tsx`)**: Converted `getServerSideProps` to an async Server Component using `headers()` from `next/headers` and Next.js Metadata API.
- **Blog Route (`app/blog/page.tsx`)**: Converted `getStaticProps` with ISR (`revalidate = 60`) to an async Server Component with typed props and client interactive elements.
- **Dynamic Blog Route (`app/blog/[id]/page.tsx`)**: Converted `getStaticPaths` to `generateStaticParams()`, `getStaticProps` to async Server Component with `notFound()` and dynamic metadata via `generateMetadata()`.
- **Error Handling (`app/not-found.tsx`, `app/error.tsx`, `app/global-error.tsx`)**: Replaced `404.js` and `_error.js` with App Router conventions and `useRouter` from `next/navigation`.
- **API Routes (`app/api/posts/route.ts`, `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts`)**: Replaced Pages API route handlers with App Router Route Handlers exporting `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `DELETE` using `NextRequest` and `NextResponse`.
- **Types & Components**: Added TypeScript definitions in `types/index.ts`, migrated `AppProvider.tsx` with `'use client'` and types, and created typed client components for interactive navigation.
- **Cleanup**: The `pages` directory has been removed. All builds and type checks succeed.
